title: Burns
text: Stop the burning: remove from heat, smother flames, cool with running water for at least 10 minutes.
Remove jewellery and loose clothing near the burn, unless stuck to the skin.
Cover loosely with cling film or a clean non-fluffy dressing; do not pop blisters or apply creams.
Burns larger than the person's palm, on face, hands, feet or joints, or any breathing difficulty need the crew medical officer at once.
